messages:
leah: Heads up — seeing a weird pattern in EU where ws half-closes then clients immediately open a new ws and we get two resume flows. Console shows a sudden bump in 'connections per session' metric.

omar: I grabbed traces. Proxy emits a halfclose on idle, client retries, then route selection changes due to capacity scoring. That triggers resume negotiation which currently issues a fresh chargeable token. snippet: 
```
[2026-03-21T09:12:01Z] session=xyz route=pool-A event=half_close
[2026-03-21T09:12:01Z] client reconnect session_hint=xyz header=X-Client-Flags:retry
[2026-03-21T09:12:02Z] route=pool-B event=resume token_issued=true charge_id=chg_987
```

rachel: Is the session id preserved across reconnects? If so we should reuse the resume token or mark resume as migration (non-chargeable) when session_guid matches.

leah: Yes session_hint is propagated but we don't attach it to billing spans right now. Billing only sees token_issued events.

omar: Two quick asks: 1) make resume token issuance idempotent for same session_guid within 30s window; 2) tag telemetry with `session_guid` and `reconnect_cause` (halfclose|route_flip|client_retry).

devops-bot: alert: ws.sessions.reconnect_rate eu-west-1 > baseline x2 for last 15m. See incident: https://internal.redwood/inc/18433

rachel: UX/Console side: add a small table showing "active_sessions vs reconnects" and expose `reconnect_cause` breakdown. That'll help correlate if proxies are half-closing vs real client churn.

leah: Thoughts on mitigation: prefer migration semantics on route change when `session_guid` matches and the reconnect occurs within 1m. Migration = transfer KV cache + lease without new billing token. This requires runtime + billing change. Short-term we can implement proxy-side dedupe where we suppress token issuance if we detect an in-flight token for that session_guid.

omar: Short-term patch plan: add in-memory recent_session map keyed by session_guid with TTL=60s. If new reconnect seen and map has an entry, mark resume as migration and set token_issued=false. We'll canary in eu-west-1 at 10%.

rachel: We need to ensure the dashboard shows when migration mode is used vs normal resume. Add two metrics: `stream.resume.migration.count` and `stream.resume.issued.count`. Create alert if issued / (migration+issued) > 0.9 after patch (we expect more migrations).

leah: Also note edge-case: multi-tab clients may legitimately open two sockets concurrently for same session_guid. We must not accidentally dedupe those into one token. Propose: only dedupe if last_disconnect_ts < 5s and origin_ip matches, else treat as independent.

omar: Good call. Will add origin_ip and last_disconnect_ts checks. Also add a log line when dedupe occurs so we can audit.

console-bot: created dashboard panel "WS reconnect causes" and added migration/issued breakdown. Link: https://internal.redwood/dash/ws-reconnects

rachel: Can we also add a billing-side guard where duplicate charge attempts within 2m for same session_guid are collapsed and only the first is billed? Billing needs to sign-off. @billing FYI.

leah: Canary plan:
- deploy in-memory dedupe + logging (10% eu-west-1)
- add telemetry tags and new console panels
- monitor `billing.tokens.duplicated.rate` and `ws.reconnects/unique_sessions`
- run for 24h then reassess.

omar: Rollback plan: flip FF off and revert dedupe map if we see dropped concurrency or customer impact. Early telemetry will tell.

rachel: I'll open a PR for console panels and the alert rule. Also posting a short note in eng-sre and product channels.

leah: Thanks — PRs incoming. Will ping once canary is live. :thumbsup:
